questions.q: Which nation is the vision of Obadiah about?
questions.evidence: This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom

questions.q: What has deceived Edom, Obadiah says?
questions.evidence: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground

questions.q: Edom is shamed for violence done to which brother?
questions.evidence: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever
